title: Remote-first support creates another delay

retrieve_on.symptom_narrative: We visit for simple settings problems, but attempted remote support can also waste 25 minutes before a visit. The remote tool may be absent, the internet down or the caller unauthorized. Customers repeat symptoms to several staff members.

discriminating_questions.question: Is network connectivity available?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Some affected PCs cannot connect at all.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: If remote readiness is high but a hardware replacement is evident, dispatch directly; remote-first is not a universal objective.

discriminating_questions.question: Who may authorize a session?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Some customers require a named on-site contact.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: Are remote attempts time-boxed?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: No; technicians keep troubleshooting connection setup.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: Do dispatch notes contain remote findings?
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

positive_mechanism: There is no eligibility gate or structured handover for remote support.
counterexample: If remote readiness is high but a hardware replacement is evident, dispatch directly; remote-first is not a universal objective.
minimum_evidence: A simulated call records loss of internet before the remote attempt.
A simulated customer policy requires attended access.
A simulated visit repeats checks absent from the ticket.
process_intervention: Ask connectivity, authorization and symptom questions first; agree a limited remote attempt and a clear escalation point.
automation_candidate: Apply a deterministic eligibility checklist; suggest remote or site triage; retain tests, errors and consent references.
unknowns: Approved tools, access policies and practical time-box thresholds need local validation.
stop_rule: If discriminating evidence is absent or conflicting, return an unresolved hypothesis plus a targeted question, not a confident solution.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: Remote eligibility logic is new; remote-control software itself is not provided.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.
